prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: In the project kickoff meeting for Northwind Logistics, it was decided to implement a three-phase rollout, starting with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in the first two weeks of May, and a decision gate before wider deployment. Key requirements include an on-premise connector for the warehouse management system, a budget consideration of up to $50,000 for the initial phase pending finance committee approval in June, and inclusion of onboarding for up to fifteen users. Action items were assigned to revise the schedule and confirm personnel allocation.
